subject: Export labels rather than IDs in results stats file

messages.author: 2f394a03b032549a
messages.subject: Export labels rather than IDs in results stats file
parts:
Is there any way to have the label of the strata and samples exported in =
the results stats file rather than the ID numbers that are assigned by th=
e Distance Software when importing the data?

I've conducted a survey that has both spatial and temporal stratification=
: 9 different strata sampled over 3 years. I have many samples (transects=
) for each strata from each year. I've used the MCDS engine to estimate d=
ensity for each sample, so that I can export the density estimates and co=
nduct a two-way ANOVA with an interaction to determine if density varies =
across strata and/or years. To do this, I've exported the restuls stats f=
ile where the rows of the stats are organized by the stratum and sample I=
Ds that are assigned by the Distance software when importing the data. Ho=
wever, because the year variable cannot be exported within this stats fil=
e (Distance allows stratification only by one variable and I've chosen to=
use my spatial strata), it is important that the density estimates be li=
nked with the original sample label, so that I can determine which year e=
ach sample came from.

Please reply to Barry Robinson: bgro...@ualberta.ca

Thanks for your time
